in_sanskrit.name: परितोष
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: परि तोषणम् (pari toshaNam) - Desiring, Wishing, Longing

in_marathi.name: Paritosh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Paritosh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Paritosh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Paritosh', which means 'God's Gift'. It is a name of great significance in Hindu culture, often given to newborn boys to symbolize the divine blessings they receive.
